direction: Second Poaster post: the how-it-works. Tip card with the 3-step flow (paste your link at poaster.co, the brand kit builds itself, download every size). Caption covers the free tier: lifetime free plan, one brand, all templates, 10 exports a day, small Made with Poaster mark that paid plans remove. Graphic: tip card, numbered.

facebook.text:
Your website already knows your brand. Your social graphics should too.

That's why we built Poaster here at Bequest. Paste your site link and it picks up your colors and type on its own. From there, every graphic matches your brand, in every size each platform wants.

There's a free plan that stays free: one brand, all the templates, 10 exports a day. Free downloads include a small Made with Poaster mark, which paid plans remove.

Start at poaster.co. You get 3 downloads before you even make an account.
